packageRules.description: fedora base image major bumps are IGNORED (not even proposed): the fedora:46/rawhide image's dnf repos serve fc45-built packages with a keyring mismatch, breaking container builds (same upstream defect as tuna-os/tacklebox#205, tuna-os/bluefin-cli#167). automerge:false alone did not stop renovate elsewhere -- tacklebox PRs #209/#211 auto-merged anyway -- so enabled:false is what prevents PR creation. e2e.yml's kde job and screenshots-kde.yml both run in quay.io/fedora/fedora:45. Carried over from frontends/kde/renovate.json, which Renovate never read: it reads only the repository root. Remove this rule once the upstream image is consistent.
